IT Professional Arrested for Counterfeiting Notes in Faridabad Hotel

Authorities in Faridabad, Haryana, have arrested an IT professional for allegedly operating a counterfeit currency racket from a hotel room. Acting on a tip-off, police seized equipment and fake notes of ₹500 and ₹100 denominations. The investigation is ongoing.
